description.en: The ID of the Prometheus instance.
The name of the monitoring configuration.

description.zh:
监控配置状态：run, stop。
probe暂不支持状态设置。
description.en: The status of the monitoring configuration. Valid values: run and stop. The status of Probe cannot be modified.

description.zh:
容器服务类型的实例支持：serviceMonitor、podMonitor、customJob。
ecs类型的实例支持：customJob。
不支持probe的状态修改。
description.en:
The type of the monitoring configuration. 
Valid values for a Prometheus instance for Container Service: serviceMonitor, podMonitor, and customJob. 
Valid value for a Prometheus instance for ECS: customJob. 
The status of probe cannot be modified.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms update-prometheus-monitoring-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --monitoring-name customJob1 --type customJob --status run --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms UpdatePrometheusMonitoringStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status run --Type customJob --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --MonitoringName customJob1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
